messages:
zoe: Heads-up: preparing RC for embed-service to address a minor rerank drift. Target cut 09:30 PT. Need litmus + 10% canary. Who can own sign-off?

carlos: I can own promo. artifact tag?

zoe: embed-service@2026-03-23-rc4-baked

deploy-bot: Candidate created: embed-service@2026-03-23-rc4-baked (id: cand-1745503333). CI green. KV-warm recommended.

qa-bot: Litmus started (smoke + rerank). ETA ~6m.

qa-bot: Litmus report: 118/120 pass. Two failures: one minor template wording, one reranker regression. See CI link.

zoe: paste failing rerank example please.

qa-bot: sample: input "Find invoice", expected top invoice-123, actual invoice-321. Looks like threshold drift.

carlos: @ops-bot can we apply a runtime config override to match prod threshold?

ops-bot: Applied runtime override on cand-1745503333: reranker.threshold=0.71. Audit cfg-1745.

qa-bot: Re-run litmus: 120/120 :white_check_mark:.

zoe: starting KV warm + traffic-split 10%. cmds: ./deployctl kv-warm --candidate=cand-1745503333 --timeout=12m; ./deployctl traffic-split --candidate=cand-1745503333 --pct=10

deploy-bot: KV warm initiated. Traffic split set to 10%.

infra-monitor: tailing p95/p99. early telemetry nominal.

zoe: proposing pin for 2-hour promo window; abort rule: sustained error_rate >0.5% for 5m. Any objections?

sheriff: ack, i'll be on-call.

carlos: pinned as pin-1745503333, ticket RB-10123 created. Final ack with "\u2705" to promote.

miguel: \u2705

sheriff: \u2705 (monitoring)

-- 09:35 PT --

deploy-bot: Promotion started for cand-1745503333 -> prod. Rolling out in 5 cohorts.

infra-monitor: Cohort 1 (5%) steady.

infra-monitor: Cohort 3 (50%) observed a brief p99 spike in us-west at t+90s; no user errors but latency spike.

sheriff: holding rollout for 3m for investigation.

carlos: investigating logs: one node had a GC burst; triggering autoscale +1 in region-us-west.

ops-bot: Autoscale event: region-us-west +1 node.

infra-monitor: metrics returning to baseline. p99 normalized.

sheriff: good to resume.

deploy-bot: Resuming rollout. Cohort 4 (80%) promoted, then cohort 5 (100%).

deploy-bot: Promotion complete: cand-1745503333 -> prod :shipit:.

zoe: Promo successful. @miguel please add a short release note to RB-10123 noting the reranker override and KV warm.

miguel: Added: "embed-service RC4-baked promoted to prod. Applied reranker.threshold runtime override (0.71) to preserve ranking parity; performed KV warm and 10% canary. No model change."

zoe: thanks all, closing thread. :tada:
